<b>Craftmetals</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|tradable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are rare materials found throughout [[Pharloom]] that can be used to craft various [[Tools]].

== Use ==
Craftmetal is used to purchase some items from [[Forge Daughter]] and [[Twelfth Architect]], as well as to craft certain Tools around the world by Hornet herself.

== How to Acquire ==
There are a total of eight Craftmetals that can be obtained, enough to acquire every tool that requires them.
